advisories.reason: Moderate AbortSignal bypass in glob 10.5.0 and 13.x, pulled in only by @opennextjs/cloudflare during the build. The deployed Worker does not accept glob patterns or run the glob CLI. The patched release is glob 14, a breaking upgrade for those callers. The glob 10 CLI injection advisory is already cleared by the 10.5.0 override.

Moderate glob-pattern DoS in minimatch 9 and 10, same OpenNext build path as the glob advisory. The patched line is minimatch 11. Build globs are fixed strings in our toolchain, not attacker-controlled note content. pnpm audit --prod does not report it.

High ReDoS in picomatch through 4.0.7, with no patched release. It is only on the ESLint path (typescript-eslint and eslint-config-next), not in the Worker bundle. Patterns there are fixed lint globs, not request input. pnpm audit --prod does not report it.
